name: Alison Zeidler
reason: Health rule: her own site (alisonzeidler.com) presents her mainly as a reflexologist and Muscle Tuner specialist and sells its sessions and workshops on burnout, anxiety, pain relief, headaches and sleep (home and sessions pages; a menopause package; even the Quantum-Touch workshop blurb promises pain relief), so too little would pass the strict energy-healing-only rule.
